    "4": {"processing_time": 69, "due_date": 240, "weight": 3},
    "5": {"processing_time": 13, "due_date": 475, "weight": 4},
    "6": {"processing_time": 16, "due_date": 128, "weight": 1},
    "7": {"processing_time": 70, "due_date": 513, "weight": 7},
    "8": {"processing_time": 6, "due_date": 143, "weight": 1},
    "9": {"processing_time": 91, "due_date": 160, "weight": 7},
    "10": {"processing_time": 56, "due_date": 555, "weight": 7},

    "13": {"processing_time": 48, "due_date": 344, "weight": 9},
    "14": {"processing_time": 85, "due_date": 244, "weight": 10}
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Sets and parameters
n = len(jobs)
job_ids = list(jobs.keys())

# Variables
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # x[i,j] = 1 if job i is in position j
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion time of job i
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness of job i

# Objective: Minimize the total weighted tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[job_ids[i]]['weight'] * T[i] for i in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Each job is assigned to exactly one position
model.addConstrs((x.sum(i, '*') == 1 for i in range(n)), name="job_assignment")

# Each position is occupied by exactly one job
model.addConstrs((x.sum('*', j) == 1 for j in range(n)), name="position_occupation")

# Calculate completion times
model.addConstrs((C[i] == gp.quicksum(jobs[job_ids[k]]['processing_time'] * x[k, j] 
                                      for k in range(n) for j in range(j+1)) 
                  for i in range(n)), name="completion_time")

# Calculate tardiness
model.addConstrs((T[i] >= C[i] - jobs[job_ids[i]]['due_date'] for i in range(n)), name="tardiness")
model.addConstrs((T[i] >= 0 for i in range(n)), name="non_negative_tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the job sequence
sequence = [None] * n
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if x[i, j].X > 0.5:
            sequence[j] = int(job_ids[i])

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(result)

n = len(jobs)
job_ids = list(jobs.keys())

# Variables
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # x[i,j] = 1 if job i is in position j
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion time of job i
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness of job i

# Objective: Minimize the total weighted tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[job_ids[i]]['weight'] * T[i] for i in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Each job is assigned to exactly one position
model.addConstrs((x.sum(i, '*') == 1 for i in range(n)), name="job_assignment")

# Each position is occupied by exactly one job
model.addConstrs((x.sum('*', j) == 1 for j in range(n)), name="position_occupation")

# Calculate completion times
model.addConstrs((C[i] == gp.quicksum(jobs[job_ids[k]]['processing_time'] * x[k, j] 
                                      for k in range(n) for j in range(n) if j <= i) 
                  for i in range(n)), name="completion_time")

# Calculate tardiness
model.addConstrs((T[i] >= C[i] - jobs[job_ids[i]]['due_date'] for i in range(n)), name="tardiness")
model.addConstrs((T[i] >= 0 for i in range(n)), name="non_negative_tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the job sequence
sequence = [None] * n
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if x[i, j].X > 0.5:
            sequence[j] = int(job_ids[i])

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
